overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the quorum's attendance at the other board's noticed meeting was not deliberation, the 501(c)(3) had not yet met, and the notice and email complaints were untimely; broad audit allegations were declined.

allegations.summary: A quorum of the advisory committee attended another board's meeting and allegedly deliberated during it.
allegations.key_passage: While a quorum of the Committee was present during the CPC meeting on January 24, 2013, there was no deliberation for purposes of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Allegedly, the committee deliberated immediately after the other board's meeting ended.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, we do not find evidence to support the assertion that the Committee improperly deliberated immediately following the meeting.

allegations.summary: A charitable 501(c)(3) organization allegedly was improperly composed of a quorum of the committee's members.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Friends of Morrison Farm has not yet convened a meeting, however, we do not find

allegations.summary: Alleged failure to post the committee's meeting minutes on the town's online records site.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review these allegations as our office will not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.

allegations.summary: Alleged that subcommittees were formed and met without posted notice or created minutes.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review these allegations as our office will not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.
